texts.value: Catalytic subunit of the Na(+)/K(+)-ATPase that hydrolyzes ATP to exchange ions across the plasma membrane, exporting 3 Na(+) and importing 2 K(+) per cycle (PubMed:33880529). It undergoes ATP-driven conformational changes that allow alternating binding and release of Na(+) and K(+) ions across the membrane (By similarity). This process maintains essential Na(+) and K(+) gradients for membrane potential and cellular function (PubMed:33880529)
